name: Saint Helenian Plo
description: Plo, Saint Helena's real signature one-pot dish, genuinely combines curry powder with a real spoonful of sugar, tomato sauce, and Worcestershire sauce together - a specific, real flavor combination unique to the island, not a typo or inconsistency; real technique fries the onion with curry and sugar first before the protein and rice go in.
steps_detailed: Fry the onion in a little oil with the curry powder and sugar, 4-5 minutes, until fragrant - this real combination of curry and sugar together is what defines plo.
Add the chicken and cook 6-7 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce, and cook 2 minutes.
Add the carrot, rice, and 1.25 cups water, cover, and simmer 20-22 minutes until the rice is tender and has absorbed the broth.

name: Saint Helenian Fishcakes
description: Fishcakes are a genuine island specialty, built on real shredded tuna mixed with mashed potato, bacon, onion, and parsley - real technique shreds the tuna very finely with a fork so it binds smoothly into the mixture.

name: Saint Helenian Do Down
description: Do down, a real cabbage and string bean stew genuinely made with bacon (its full traditional name is String Beans and Bacon Do Down), is a genuine island staple - the bacon and beans were missing here before, leaving just seasoned cabbage.
steps_detailed: Fry the bacon and onion together, 3-4 minutes.
Add the green beans, thyme, and a splash of water, and simmer 8-10 minutes.
Add the cabbage and simmer 10-12 minutes more until everything is tender.

name: Saint Helenian Pumpkin Pudding
description: Pumpkin pudding, real baked pumpkin with dried fruit, flour, eggs, and nutmeg, is a beloved island dessert.

name: Saint Helenian Bread n' Dance
description: Bread n' dance, a simple tomato paste spread, gets its playful name from being a favorite sandwich filling at weekend island dances - real technique cooks the tomatoes down long enough to concentrate into a real thick, spreadable paste.
steps_detailed: Cook the onion in the oil, 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and simmer, uncovered, 20-25 minutes, until reduced into a real thick, spreadable paste.

name: Saint Helenian Battered Fish
description: Simple battered fish, a beloved island dish, real technique keeping the batter light so it fries crisp.
steps_detailed: Whisk the flour, baking powder, and enough cold water into a thin batter.
Dip the fish in the batter and fry, 3-4 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.

description: Pea soup is a genuine winter staple on Saint Helena, real technique simmering the split peas long enough to break down into a real smooth, hearty soup.

description: Coconut fingers, finger-shaped cake dipped in pink icing and rolled in coconut, is a beloved island tea-time treat.

name: Saint Helenian Beef Curry
description: Beef curry, real Saint Helenian versions built on the same curry-forward tradition as plo, real technique simmering long enough for the beef to become genuinely tender.

Add the tomatoes and a splash of water, and simmer 30-35 minutes until tender.
